title: Commons Statistics computes representable scaled Cauchy tail quantiles
summary: The two ordinary tails became distinct and accurate. A small scale with a subnormal probability still returned two infinities despite finite, representable reference answers.

change.description: The distribution now evaluates the two inverse tails without subtracting one half from a tiny probability.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
The finite scaled tail returned infinities on master at 8381f56aa3ec. Release 1.3 predates the repair and returns a different wrong finite result for the same input.
